question: Which registry class do delivered addresses have for SolaDrive Ashburn and Los Angeles, Tokyonline, ResidentialVPS, NodeMach, Shlii and SixtyNet?
why: Only SolaDrive (three test addresses) and Residential-IDC (two) publish test addresses, and those registry lookups are recorded; the other vendors publish none, so a registry check needs a delivered address, which needs an account and a purchase.
